# Daily Report — 2026-10-25

## Task Completed
Add sys_property tools (list_properties, get_property, set_property, delete_property) on the
sys_properties table. Properties are global key-value settings accessible via gs.getProperty()
in ServiceNow server-side scripts. set_property upserts: PATCH if the name already exists, POST
otherwise. get_property and delete_property accept a 32-char hex sys_id or an exact property name.
list_properties supports name (substring), category (exact), and type filters with pagination.
All four tools registered in the system_administrator and full packages.
